text.en:
Section two thousand six hundred and seventeen of the Revised Administrative Code is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"Section 2617. Election of president, vice-president and councilors.-The president, vice-president and
councilors of a municipality or municipal district shall be chosen by the qualified electors of the municipality
or municipal district in accordance with the provisions, of the Election Law, but no election shall be held in
any municipal district unless one is called for such district by a proclamation of the President of the
Philippines."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 13, 1936.
